messages:
kate_dl: quick heads-up — NovoMed POC moving forward. They're OK with 60d trial but asked for a one-time 'pilot license' invoice of $6k, plus 10h remote setup support. Also pushed a change to the DPA: they want a 90-day retention window for logs (we typically do 30). Can legal/ops advise next steps?
claire_legal: pls drop the SOW/orderform and the specific DPA clause they redlined. i can triage but 90d for logs sounds high — need rationale and scope. cc @ryan_procurement for PO routing.
evan_se: for the POC acceptance criteria — they want 3 endpoints tested at 2k rps total, latency <= 120ms p50. we'll confirm capacity but might need dedicated pool for predictable perf.
sam_sales: pricing note — they asked if the $6k pilot can be credited to first month if they convert. we can do a 100% credit within 90 days if legal OK.
ryan_procurement: PO will route to their AP. are we OK with net30? they asked for net45 but finance prefers net30 for pilots. also who signs — they want countersign from Dir of Procurement.
kate_dl: attaching basic orderform snippet below for clarity:
```
Item: Pilot license (60d)
Qty: 1
One-time: $6,000
Support: 10h remote onboarding (hourly)
Billing: Net30 by invoice
Convert credit: Full credit to month1 if contract executed within 90d
```
claire_legal: thanks. i'll propose two edits: (1) keep log retention at 30d for debug/metrics; if they need 90d we can offer as a paid addendum with RBAC scoping (2) clarify data deletion process in DPA section 4.2. also need to narrow subprocessors.
claire_legal: asking contract question — do we have SOC2 report we can share under NDA? if yes, i'll link it in the DPA response.
contracts_bot: shared link to SOC2 report (internal) — https://redwood.internal/soc2/shortlink (access: legal+sales)
evan_se: for perf: if we need dedicated pool that'll add $1200/month to committed capacity. call that out as optional line item.
sam_sales: ok to show optional capacity line item on orderform. can we add a checkbox: "Add dedicated capacity: $1,200/mo" so procurement sees it separately.
ryan_procurement: routing question — do we need exec approval for credit-back clause? finance needs a sign-off if we allow conversion credit.
kate_dl: i'll open an orderform redline with the changes and route to @claire_legal. goal: get countersigned PO by next Fri EOB.
claire_legal: drafting redline now. i'll include an alternate clause for retention (30d default, 90d addendum) + data deletion schedule + subprocessors list.
kate_dl: also need a short SSQ response pack — they included a 20-question security questionnaire. evan — can you answer the infra/network questions? i'll own app/data controls.
evan_se: will take infra/network Qs. can you upload the SSQ doc to the folder and tag me?
kate_dl: uploaded SSQ to /sales/novomed/poc/ — tagged you.
sam_sales: timeline: we need legal redline back by Wed, PO by Fri. i'll prep a one-pager for buyer that summarizes costs and signature path.
ryan_procurement: once redline is accepted we'll need PO number to route invoice. prefer electronic signature via DocuSign.
ateam: @contracts_bot can we create a DocuSign envelope with the redlined orderform when ready?
contracts_bot: will prepare envelope; need final redline file and signer names.
claire_legal: note on SLA: NovoMed asked for 99.95% for production. for a POC we propose no SLA, but for conversion we can offer 99.9% with credit cap 10x monthly fee. i'll include option language.
kate_dl: acknowledged. i'll coordinate with product if they push SLA higher.
sam_sales: any blockers from security side that would stall signature?
evan_se: SSQ has a few items about key management and VPC peering we can answer, nothing blocking. only potential delay if they request HSM-backed keys — that's procurement-level.
kate_dl: action items — claire to post redline (today), evan to complete SSQ infra answers (tomorrow AM), contracts_bot to queue DocuSign once redline approved, sam to prep buyer one-pager. I'll follow up at 10am standup.
claire_legal: done — redline uploaded to /sales/novomed/poc/redline_2376543210.docx and comments inlined. pls review.
sam_sales: looked — LGTM except we need to decide on the convert-credit timeframe (90d vs 60d).
kate_dl: i'll ask customer if 60d works, call scheduled 4pm.
ryan_procurement: noted. tagging finance for net terms decision.
kate_dl: thanks team — looping back after 4pm call. :thumbsup:
